pure_face: all positive-area evaluation patches on the original face have one region label; distinct from >=90%
face_identity: original CityGML polygon ID; original LoD2 patch surf_ext mapped through immutable surface tables
face_name: roofs by original 3D polygon area descending, GML ID tie; walls by outward normal cardinal direction, then XY,Z and ID
building_user_clarification: 패치 중심이 LoD2 GroundSurface 평면 범위 안에 유일하게 드는 건물. 범위 밖이면 1 m 안 후보가 하나일 때만 연결. 겹침, 복수 후보, 1 m 밖은 붙지 않음. 이 발주에서 구한 연결로 표시.
als_face: same assigned building; minimum XY distance to closed roof polygon (inside is zero); <=1m; equal minima sorted original GML ID with tie count retained; no height selection
changed_building_note: B173은 평면 범위가 같아도 높이가 다를 수 있다. 면 이름과 경계는 기존 LoD2의 것이다.
scope: exact stored in_eval for four experiment units; JUDGENUM exact frozen development/holdout membership for census; no band in maps
matching_denominators: report matching area / total evaluation area and / comparable area (region 1..3 AND cell0..2), separately; unobserved, removed, unavailable, cells3..6 retained
baseline_denominator: area with truth cells0..3, same face and scope for both baselines
raster_rule: world-aligned 0.25m XY bins for all evaluation patch centres; sum original patch area per class in cell; maximum area class; ties ascending numeric code. Display area is not statistical area.
raster_mismatch: area-majority decision and cell labels, comparable pairs only; separate 4-neighbour connected regions inside each dominant original face; red dashed external pixel edges; no dilation
photo_rule: training images only; building centre projected inside frame; tilt<=15deg first, else minimum available tilt+1deg explicitly noted; smallest normalized distance to image centre, then tilt and image name; crop/mask only requested experiment building's projected evaluation geometry
wall_rule: south, east, north, west cardinal groups; contiguous endpoints first within group; each face uses metric tangent distance and shared absolute local Z. Cumulative face width; discontinuous joins visibly separated and counted, no invented corner continuity.
purity_population: individual original faces with positive evaluation area including <1m2 faces; tables alone combine small faces by kind; no counting an aggregate small-face row as one face
aggregate_regions: four experiment units overlap; no pooled distinct-population claim; report each separately
holdout: per-face and per-patch details only /out/holdout; public counts, areas, ratios only; no holdout images or archive entries
r7: run only after separately verifiable locked stage0 inputs and explicit region code meanings exist; reuse identical face catalog and association; absent is unavailable, never recomputed here
